versions.changelog:
Initial release of Lecture Notes Master — structured Obsidian note generator with recursive atomic decomposition.

- Generates main hub note, deeply layered atomic notes (≥3 levels), and unlimited glossary entries from lectures, articles, videos, transcripts, or PDFs.
- Organizes all notes into numbered topic subdirectories and a dedicated glossary folder, following strict atomic/note structure rules.
- Ensures every atomic note follows a rich template: definition, motivation, diagrams, comparison tables, pitfalls, takeaways, review questions, and related links.
- Supports bilingual term entries and outputs in Obsidian markdown with built-in Mermaid diagrams and wikilinks.
- Designed for easy import into user-defined Obsidian vaults; customizable for study, exam prep, and knowledge management.
